question: With which sport is the Rovers Cup associated?
solution:
The correct answer is " **Football** ".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Rovers Cup** was an annual football tournament held in India, organized by the **Western India Football Association**.
 
• It was the** second oldest tournament** in India after Durand Cup.
 
• Rovers Cup was incorporated by some **British football enthusiasts in Bombay**, Bombay Presidency, in 1890, as a form of amusement.
 
• After the foundation of Bombay Football Association (BFA) in 1902, the tournament became well organized.
 
• Patronized by Justice Russell, the tournament was firstly opened to British teams.
 
• Later in 1911, Western India Football Association was founded as a result of merger between BFA and Rovers Cup Committee.
